ride_purpose: Bukit Kiara Enduro/DH practice on S-Works Enduro MY25 with Zeb Ultimate setup evaluation.
skill_quality: Lap 4 was ridden at about 70% effort but hit bigger compressions faster because rebound setup was better. Lap 2 rebound was too fast, so Clayton rolled over obstacles rather than loading and carrying speed through them.
lap_context: Lap 2 and lap 4 are the same Enduro Stage. Lap 6 is half of the DH/Enduro stage. Interpret lap 4 as a suspension-control improvement and submaximal confidence rep, not a full race-effort benchmark.
bike_setup: Zeb rebound was too fast on lap 2. Better rebound setup by lap 4 improved compression support and speed through bigger hits.
notes: Future Kiara loop comparisons should separate physiological load from suspension setup confidence. Lap 4 being faster at 70% suggests setup and confidence unlocked speed before fitness became the limiter.
